$comment: Harbor known-services config. Hand-edited; Harbor reads it (Reload button in the UI re-reads without a restart). Each service is matched to a running process BY PORT. 'port' may be a single number or an array of numbers for multi-port services. 'autostart' (default false) starts the service when Harbor launches at login. 'cwd' and 'command' are used to spawn it; the command runs through your shell in that directory.
